verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail documents AI summaries, automatic labels and categorization that help users 'stay on top of' their mail, which could plausibly surface important items. Nothing shows that government, IRS, state-filing or service-of-process mail is specifically detected, flagged or prioritized. Missing for 10: documented detection of government/legal senders, priority flagging or alerts for compliance mail, deadline-oriented surfacing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operator, government and legal mail — IRS, state filings, service of process — is flagged or prioritized so a compliance deadline never sits unread in the pile

citations.quote: Get instant AI summaries and automatic labels that help you stay on top of your mail, save time, and keep your inbox organized.
AI summaries and categorization that help you save time and stay organized
